newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at a standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at a standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade continues at a standstill on Tuesday morning, USDA said. Dressed Basis Delivered. (paid on hot carcass weights) Steers and heifers not established.
Dressed Basis Steers - No confirmed sales.
Dressed Basis Heifers - No confirmed sales.

No sales on slaughter steers or heifers reported. Buyer inquiry and seller interest light. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Slaughter Steers - No confirmed sales Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - None For the week - 1,200
